agent_priors_used: Planning pathology prior: agents overweight recent trajectories and retrieved mechanisms, producing local optima and compounding errors over 10-30 steps; without calibrated abstention they prefer false_accept over UNKNOWN when retrieval is noisy — distinct from SPIDER evidence, used to prioritize correct-family gating and ECE/precision gates

Cost compression prior: first-agent cold search dominates cost; later-agent compression requires residual novelty << task length and independent handles on novelty fraction (0/25/50/75/100%) and length (L=8-14) to avoid confounded correlations — used to require honest summed-counters cost and stratified/block-permutation controls

Substrate locality prior: per-node state (SQLite, CDN semantics, session affinity) makes 'local' Web change non-local; bounded repair needs shared store or sticky affinity plus oracle-free byte-identical cache before measurable — used to prioritize runtime shared WAL + sticky over CDN branching

Estimator complementarity prior: high-dimensional density estimators have complementary blind spots (kNN fails scaling rho=-0.07, KDE fails rotation rho=0.286) and per-type CV needs n>>250/type; pooling vs per-type is sample-size not estimator superiority — used to park further TV/KDE tuning and favor parsimonious Dirichlet-Multinomial only if substrate valid

Compilation vs retrieval prior: wrapping reuse as deterministic workflow compilation with guards outperforms semantic similarity when action has destination leakage (action.target_href==state_after.url 78-98%); history-conditioned baselines required — used to select tool-bypass/OpenAPI discovery and WebMCP O(1) over another flat vs hierarchical RAG variant
